Both steps are committed in `worktree/task-replay`, tests pass, and I sent the two hashes and results to `mastermind-task-system`. Nothing is merged.

- **Step 1 (`a5c500aa0`):** `Task.replay`, the `waiting` state and lazy `tasks` are in. `Task.test.mjs` passes 21/21 (the 11 old plus 10 new).
- **Step 2 (`2c7dd6e1a`):** `TaskLoop` and `TaskState` now read state through `Task.replay`. `TaskLoop-state.test.mjs` (fixtures in `Servex/fixtures/task-state/`) and `TaskState.test.mjs` both pass; they print an all-checks-passed line, not a count.
- **Existing steps test:** `TaskLoop-steps.test.mjs` passes every assertion but then fails with EPERM when it deletes its temp folder. The main tree's copy fails the same way, so I didn't touch it.
- **Open legacy tasks:** before the first explicit state line, an open legacy task stays `idle` instead of `running`, so an explicit `start` is legal. Once an explicit line appears, those lines decide.
- **Shared card path:** `escalate()`'s card posting is now `post_card()`, which the owner reminders also use.
- **Parent lookup:** `parent_task` is looked up as a path under the repo root or `ai/`, then falls back to the owning agent.
- **Docs not updated:** `Servex/doc/task-loop.md` doesn't list `SERVEX_TASKLOOP_FOLLOWUP_MIN` yet; it wasn't in my files.

Step 3 is built and committed as `722f3aa2a` on `worktree/task-fields`. I haven't merged it. The report reached `mastermind-task-system` through Servex, since SendMessage couldn't find it.

- **`Task.js`:**
  - **Getters:** `expected`, `priority`, `commits`, `session` and `module`, plus `commit(hash)` and `check({by})`.
  - **`complete`:** follows your order: `checked_by`, then subtasks, then old `steps`, then the agent's value.
  - **Replay:** reads `commit` and `priority` lines, and a legacy open file with commit lines stays `running`.
- **`Agents.js`:** line 1 of a new task no longer writes `steps` or `step`.
- **Steps readers:** `Steps.parse`, `stats.js` and `tree.js` already treat a missing `steps` as an empty list, so I changed none of them. I didn't check `Servex/TaskLoop.js` or `AITask.js:235` beyond that.
- **Readme:** added a few lines on the fields and `complete`, and updated the pass count to 28/28.

**Tests**
- `Task.test.mjs`: 28/28 pass (the 22 old ones plus 6 new).
- `TaskLoop-state.test.mjs` and `TaskState.test.mjs`: pass.
- `TaskLoop-steps.test.mjs`: every assertion passes, but it then fails with a permission error deleting its temp folder on Windows. It never prints "all checks passed".

I didn't write to my `task.jsonl` log; I only used the `append.mjs` rule from the brief as a guide.

I committed the task view as `f83529aad` on `worktree/task-view`, but I couldn't send it to `mastermind-task-system` because that agent isn't reachable. None of the five sessions `ListAgents` shows is it, so I didn't guess one. I haven't merged. The commit adds `TaskView` (chip, row and card), `Task.render()`, and `this.task` on `AITask`. It also retires the display `Task` from `ai/objects.js` and updates the `core/Task` page, the readme and the Overview Objects section.

**Checked**
- **Node test:** `Task.test.mjs` passes 29/29, including a new test that `render()` warns once and returns `undefined` with no DOM.
- **Headless pages:** I loaded four pages in headless Playwright on `monorepo.localhost`, with my worktree's changed files swapped in by request interception. They are `core/Task` (at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440), `ai/objects`, the `task-replay` page and the `task-system` page. None showed a JS error.
- **Rendering:** On `core/Task` and `ai/objects` the three `TaskView` elements render. I looked at the 1200 screenshot of `core/Task` only, not the other widths or pages.
- **404s:** `task-replay` and `task-system` each show 404s for `page.js` files in `voice-20261016/` and `task-system/`. I assumed they predate my change and didn't confirm against the main branch.

**Not done**
- **`AITask` state label:** The state label appears on both task pages (3 and 2 on the headless run). I didn't read what they said, and I didn't confirm the Steps checklist hides when a task has no steps.
- **Live redraw:** I didn't exercise the live redraw on task changes, or the card's redraw on subtask add, remove and reorder.
- **Commit-only changes:** `put()` and `commit()` emit no change event, so a view won't redraw when only a commit is added. A replayed task is rebuilt each time, so `AITask` is unaffected.
- **`task.jsonl`:** I didn't append anything to my own `task.jsonl`.

Step 5 is committed as `cdab14844` on `worktree/item-tool`. I haven't merged it, and I couldn't message `mastermind-task-system`, so this is my report.

**Checks**
- **New test:** `node Servex/agents/item_tool.test.mjs` passes 12 of 12. It covers `start` giving `running` with one stamped line, and `tasks.add` giving completion 0 with one child. It also covers the `_secret` and unknown-key refusals with `exists`, `now.preview` expanding, and instructions on the first call only (then `{"help":{}}` again). Last, `page_set` writing through the same function.
- **`Task.test.mjs`:** still passes 42 of 42.
- **`page_tools.test.mjs`:** fails at "page.js parent: children gets the new name". That check exercises `Subpages` directly, which I didn't touch, so I think it was failing before my change. I didn't run it on the original code to confirm.
- **Servex:** not restarted, and I did not test through the live MCP.

**What I built**
- **The tool:** `item` is in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`, and `page_set` now calls the same function.
- **Which log:** `task.jsonl` beside a `page.jsonl` means a task folder, and a `class` key on line 1 wins.
- **`Item.describe()`:** added to `Item.js`. Method docs are filled in by the tool from the source files.
- **Docs:** new `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`, plus a line in the Task readme.

**Decisions and gaps**
- **Schema check skipped:** I skipped the `jsonl-schema` check for Task lines. Its `task.jsonl` rules allow one verb per line and no `by` or `ts`, which conflicts with the stamping you specified. The tool validates Task lines itself.
- **`tasks` lines:** `Task.replay` doesn't read a `tasks` line, and `Task.js` is outside my files. So the tool applies it itself with `task.tasks.set`. `Task.replay` should do this, and I've flagged it in the Task readme.
- **Not tested or built:** the `Session` class check is skipped, as the brief allowed. A Page delta is not validated beyond what `page_set` did.

Step 12 is committed as `3b47f5159` on `worktree/item-local`. I haven't merged it, and I've sent the hash and a short report to `mastermind-task-system`. All three test runs pass: the new `item-local.test.mjs` (6 checks), `item_tool.test.mjs` (13/13) and `Task.test.mjs` (42/42).

- **What changed:** `door()` now gives each Servex-spawned agent an in-process page-tools server named `local`. The agent sees `mcp__local__item`, `page_set`, `page_add`, `page_log`, `page_read` and `page_call`. The HTTP `servex` entry stays.
- **No double tools:** the six `mcp__servex__` twins go into `disallowedTools`. `options()` merges them with the agent's own `sdk` list and the OpenRouter list instead of replacing either.
- **Off switch:** `SERVEX_LOCAL_TOOLS=0` gives today's HTTP-only behaviour. The no-URL branch of `door()` is untouched.
- **Docs:** I added a short section to `Servex/doc/sdk.md` and one line to `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`.
- **Deviation:** the test calls `item` through `page_tools()`, because the SDK server doesn't expose its handlers. It checks that `{start: {}}` gives `state: "running"`. So the test doesn't prove the SDK server's own wrapper runs the handler.
- **Not done:** I started no real agent and didn't restart Servex, so the change takes effect after your next restart.
- **Side effect:** the worktree had no `node_modules`, so I ran `npm install` inside its `Servex/` folder. The folder is gitignored and isn't in the commit.

Step 6 is committed as `3356c7710d9f` on `worktree/task-commits` and not merged. I couldn't reach `mastermind-task-system`, so I put the report in a `log` line in my own `task.jsonl`.

- **`SERVEX_TASK`:** `door()` in `Agents.js` now puts the absolute path of the agent's `task.jsonl` in its env, in both branches, whenever it has a task dir. With no task there is no variable. The path resolves against the main tree.
- **Hook:** `Server/git-hooks/post-commit.mjs` appends `{"commit":"<12-char hash>"}` through `append.mjs`. It skips a hash that is already logged, and any error prints one line and exits 0.
- **Install:** `Server/git-hooks/install.mjs` has run, and the shared `.git/hooks/post-commit` is live in every worktree. Your existing `post-merge` hook is untouched.
- **Tests:** `Server/git-hooks/post-commit.test.mjs` passes. It covers one `commit` line after a commit, none when `SERVEX_TASK` is unset, no duplicate on a second run, exit 0 on a missing file, and the `door()` checks. `item-local.test.mjs` passes, and `Task.test.mjs` passes 42/42.
- **Test setup:** this worktree has no `node_modules`, so I ran the `Agents.js` tests through a temporary resolver hook that borrows the main tree's SDK.
- **Docs:** I added a few lines to `Server/readme.md` and `public/framework/core/Task/readme.md`.

Session now extends Item and has tasks; it's committed as `b6d4b103c` on `worktree/session-item`, not merged. I sent the report to `mastermind-task-system`.

- **Progress:** `progress()` returns `{done, total}` and `completion` is the share of complete tasks, computed on read. Both go through one new static, `Task.progress_of(list)`, which `Task` now uses too.
- **Replay:** `Session.replay(lines)` builds a Session from log lines, so a `tasks.add` line adds a task. A task added by that line needs `"type":"Task"` to come back as a real Task, the same as for `Task` today.
- **Item tool:** `session.jsonl` now maps to the real Session class in `page_tools.js`. A call returns `{class:"Session", completion, progress, data, tasks}` and refuses unknown keys.
- **Name clash:** `AISession.on(fn)` collided with Item's `on(event, fn)`. I renamed it to `subscribe(fn)` and updated its three callers. Two of them (`AISessionView.js`, `classes/Session/SessionClassPage.js`) are outside your file list. I did not audit AISession's other methods against Item's: `render` and `save` also override Item's but don't conflict, so I left them.
- **Tests:** `Session.test.mjs` 5/5, `Task.test.mjs` 42/42, `item_tool.test.mjs` 15/15 (13 plus 2 new session checks), `item-local.test.mjs` 6/6.
- **Headless render:** both `/framework/ai/sessions/` and the `voice-20261016` session page load on a static server. The only console errors are dev-server websocket and API fetches, which that server doesn't have; there are no module or import errors.
- **Leftover:** I copied the main tree's `Servex/node_modules` into the worktree for the `item-local` test and couldn't remove it, because the git-guard blocks recursive deletes there. It's git-ignored, so it isn't in the commit.
- **Docs:** I added a short section to `core/Session/readme.md`. Any doc that mentions `AISession.on` is now out of date.

Step 8 is committed in the worktree as `e2737253a`. I haven't merged it.

Each ask that `after_refine` newly records now also becomes an idle Task in the heard session's `task.jsonl`, added through the item tool with `source: {session, line, id}`. A repeat call adds none. `AskIndex.tasks_view(dir)` lists a folder's asks-as-tasks read-only.

I ran four of the five checks you listed:
- **New test:** `Server/AskIndex-tasks.test.mjs` passes. It covers the two stamped tasks, the no-duplicate repeat, `tasks_view`, and the missing-folder skip.
- **Existing suites:** the existing `AskIndex` test, `item_tool.test.mjs`, `Task.test.mjs` and `Session.test.mjs` still pass.
- **Not run:** I did not run RefineQueue for real or call Haiku. The test uses a temp folder under `public/` and never touches a real session folder.

- **`after_refine` return shape:** it returns the same `{recorded, done, inboxed}` as before. The task counts `{added, skipped, no_folder}` come from awaiting the non-enumerable `n.tasks` promise, because the item tool is async and the old test asserts the exact shape.
- **`source` field:** I added `source` to `Task.FIELDS`.
- **`run_item`:** I exported it from `page_tools.js`.
- **Docs:** I added doc lines to `ext/Refine/doc/asks.md` and `core/Task/readme.md`, and one "later" line to `Servex/asks/readme.md`.

Left undone, as scoped: retiring the old `asks.jsonl` writers (noted as a later step) and a `priority` on the task, since rows don't carry one.

Step 13 is done and committed as `f75eb869e` on `worktree/item-replay`. I've sent the report to `mastermind-task-system`, and it's also logged in my `task.jsonl`.

- **One replay on Item:** `Item.replay` builds the item, calls `replay_line` per line, then the optional `replay_end`. `Store.read` now calls `host.replay_line`, so the browser and node take the same path.
- **Task and Session:** Task keeps only its legacy mapping, and `Task.replay` is Item's static. Session inherits it and only overrides how it builds from line 1 and how it reads a line. I also reset the pinned clock after each verb line, so a live `Store.read` never leaves a Task's clock pinned.
- **`tags`:** `[module, ...own tags, ...parent's tags]`, with no duplicates or empties, and `tags` is in `FIELDS`. I also added `tags` to `TASK_KEYS` in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`, so the item tool accepts it.
- **`expected`:** a string or an array, and the type survives replay. `TaskView.card()` draws each string as its own line.
- **`approve`:** now goes waiting → running, with a comment that no delay queue exists yet. The Task and Item readmes are updated.

**Tests:**
- **Passing:** Item 5 assertions, Task 47/47 (5 new, and 3 existing approve asserts changed idle → running), Session 5/5, `item_tool` 15/15, `AskIndex-tasks`, `TaskState`, `TaskLoop-state`.
- **Existing assert changed:** `Servex/TaskLoop-state.test.mjs` asserted that an approved task gets no reminder. It is now running, so TaskLoop chases it like any quiet running task, and I changed that assert to expect one chase.
- **`TaskLoop-steps` cleanup error:** its asserts pass, but the script ends with the known Windows EPERM error when it deletes its temp dir.
- **Headless:** `/framework/core/Task/` and `/framework/core/Task/live/` load with no console errors except the live-reload WebSocket, which a static server can't serve.

**Left undone:**
- `Store.read` never calls `replay_end`, so the Task's "infer state from `landed_at` / `closed_by`" pass doesn't run when a Task loads through a Store. That pass would have to run per batch of a live tail, which seemed wrong to add unasked.
- The yes/no check at `complete()` and the approve delay queue are later steps.

Step 14a is committed as `8769fb71a` on `worktree/task-homes`, not merged, and I've messaged `mastermind-task-system` with the details.

- **Home:** `tasks.add` on a Task or Session parent now makes the child its own folder. It goes in `<module>/tasks/<slug>/` when `public/framework/<module>/` already exists, and in `<parent>/<slug>/` otherwise, with `-2`, `-3` on a repeated title. The child's line 1 holds its own data plus its `path` and `parent`.
- **Parent:** it gets one `{"task": "<app path>"}` line and no copied data.
- **Resolving:** replay turns each reference into a live child (`Task.from_ref`), and a missing file gives a stub with state `missing` instead of throwing. `Session.js` and the `AskIndex` dedupe use the same hook, and `completion` counts the resolved children. Old inline `tasks.add` lines still replay inline.
- **Checks:** `item_tool` 26 checks, `Task` 47/47, `Session` 5/5 and `AskIndex-tasks` all pass. `page_tools.test.mjs` shows only the known "children gets the new name" failure.
- **Test edits:** I changed the `AskIndex-tasks` and `item_tool` session tests because the line shapes changed. The new tests cover each case in the brief.
- **Added:** a `ctx.module_root` option, so tests can point the module root at a temp dir.
- **Left undone:** step 14b, which is the browser Store resolving references and a module page listing its tasks. Servex needs a restart to load the new `page_tools`.

Step 14b is committed as `40341fd0a` on `worktree/task-homes-browser`, not merged. `mastermind-task-system` wasn't reachable, so this note goes to you instead.

I also logged it in my `task.jsonl` in the main tree, because the worktree has no task folder.

**What I built**
- **Browser references:** `Task.from_ref` now returns a "loading" stub that opens the child's own `task.jsonl` through the Store and tails it live. It shows `missing` only after a 404.
- **Module task list:** `make_child` now writes `<module>/tasks/task.jsonl`, with line 1 once and one reference per child.
- **Child routes:** `make_child` also writes a two-line `page.js` in each new child folder. The Router reached it with no changes, so `/framework/core/Item/tasks/running-job/` opened the task full-size.
- **Doc Tasks tab:** Every Doc page gets a Tasks tab, built when the tab opens, before Inbox. `no_tasks: true` opts out, and an empty module says "No tasks yet".
- **`Task.rank`:** I added it as you asked, with a node test of three tasks in `item_tool.test.mjs`.

**Checks**
- **Node tests:** `item_tool` (31 checks), `Task` 47/47, `Session`, `Item` and `AskIndex-tasks` all pass.
- **Headless check:** I ran it with Playwright and fixture folders, which I deleted afterwards.
  - The list showed a complete and a running child, each with its state from its own file.
  - `/framework/core/Task/tasks/` said "No tasks yet".
  - `/framework/core/Item/` loaded with no console errors.
  - The list's errors were only 404s from my route stub and failed WebSocket and CORS fetches.

**Left undone**
- **Live tail:** The Playwright check ran without the dev-server socket, so I didn't exercise the live tail.
- **Docs:** I added one line each to the Task and Doc readmes, but wrote no `doc/` note for the Tasks tab.

Step 16 is committed as `ee4c71f37` on `worktree/tool-files-refs`. I haven't merged it, and `mastermind-task-system` has the report. I did not run `item-local.test.mjs`, so the in-process tool path is untested. The worktree has no `node_modules`, and I won't link one. Run that test from a tree that has the Claude agent SDK package.

- **Caller's log:** every `tasks.add` now also appends the `{"task": path}` line to the calling agent's own `task.jsonl`. It writes nothing extra when there is no caller, no task dir, or the caller's log is the parent.
- **Module from the path:** an add with no `module` is homed under the nearest folder under `public/framework/` that has a `readme.md`, taken from the path the call was made on. A dated `ai/sessions/` path keeps the parent's folder.
- **Rules:** the first-call instructions now carry a `rules` list with the five grouping rules, and `Servex/doc/item-tool.md` has the same rules once.

I could not run the cost reader: the worktree has no `node_modules`, so `Agents.js` can't import the SDK there, and it only passed `node --check`. `Task.test.mjs` passes 50/50 and `item_tool.test.mjs` passes 56 checks, with new tests for `sessions`, `source` and `cost`.

- **`sessions`:** a `Task` getter returns the list, empty when absent. `run_item` appends one line with the full list the first time a new caller touches a task. A new module task also gets its creator on line 1.
- **`source`:** node writes it on line 1 of a module task, as `servex:<caller>`. It uses `ctx.source` if given, and `SERVEX_AGENT` when there is no caller. An old value starting with `/` reads as `doc`, and `source` is then `undefined`.
- **`cost`:** `Task.cost` is computed through `Task.cost_resolver`, which `Agents` wires to a new `Agents.task_cost(dir)`. That sums the existing `logged_cost` over the agents whose task dir matches.

Two things to know: a caller's first touch of a task now adds one extra `sessions` line, so the existing test expects 3 lines instead of 2. Inline subtasks (no folder of their own) don't get `source` or `sessions` on their first line yet.
